name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl, Halpern, Mayor Pro Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of March 12, 2025 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

2939375.2
 MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Chamber of Commerce – Quarterly Report (Verbal Report)

4.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 24-003; RESOLUTION NO. 2394-25 -
  Adopt Resolution No. 2394-25, determining Planned Development Permit No. 24-
  003 is exempt from CEQA and approving Planned Development Permit No. 24-
  003 authorizing exterior renovations, including painting and improvements to the
  existing building facades and storefronts at the North Ranch Gateway shopping
  center located at 30805 - 30895 E. Thousand Oaks Boulevard.

  RESOLUTION NO 2394-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT (PDP) NO. 24-
  003 TO AUTHORIZE EXTERIOR RENOVATIONS, INCLUDING PAINTING AND
  IMPROVEMENTS TO THE EXISTING BUILDING FACADES AND STOREFRONTS AT
  THE NORTH RANCH GATEWAY SHOPPING CENTER LOCATED AT 30805 - 30895 E.
  THOUSAND OAKS BOULEVARD

2.  FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 ASSESSMENTS FOR LIGHTING AND LANDSCAPE
  ASSESSMENT DISTRICTS: RESOLUTION NOS. 2395-25, 2396-25 AND 2397-
  25 - Adopt Resolution Numbers 2395-25, 2396-25, and 2397-25 to Levy the
  Assessments for Fiscal Year 2025-26 within the Lighting Maintenance District No.
  1, Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 and Westlake Spectrum Landscape
  District No. 15; and that the City Clerk and City Engineer be directed to file a
  certified copy of the Resolutions, Annual Assessments and Diagrams with the Los
  Angeles County Auditor-Controller.

  RESOLUTION NO 2395-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE CONFIRMING A DIAGRAM AND ASSESSMENT FOR THE 2025-
  26 FISCAL YEAR, AND ORDERING THE IMPROVEMENTS IN CONNECTION WITH
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE LIGHTING MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT
  NO. 1 PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF DIVISION 15 OF THE
  STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE
   RESOLUTION NO 2396-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE CONFIRMING A DIAGRAM AND ASSESSMENT FOR THE
  2025-26 FISCAL YEAR, AND ORDERING THE IMPROVEMENTS IN CONNECTION
  WITH WESTLAKE VILLAGE LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT
  NO. 1 PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF DIVISION 15 OF THE
  STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE

  RESOLUTION NO. 2397-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE CONFIRMING A DIAGRAM AND ASSESSMENT FOR THE
  2025-26 FISCAL YEAR, AND ORDERING THE IMPROVEMENTS IN CONNECTION
  WITH WESTLAKE SPECTRUM LOCAL LANDSCAPE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT NO. 15
  PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF DIVISION 15 OF THE STREETS
  AND HIGHWAYS CODE

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective March 15, 2025 in the amount
  of $565,054.82.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  PUBLIC SAFETY ADVISORY BOARD APPOINTMENTS - Reappoint to
  the Public Safety Advisory Board Ted Corwin and Shirley Richards and
  appoint Gabriel Albarian all with the term ending March 31, 2027.

  2.  AGREEMENT WITH FINALSITE (FORMERLY BLACKBOARD
  CONNECT) FOR ALERT AND WARNING NOTIFICATION SYSTEMS -
  Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Finalsite for alert and
  warning notification systems and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute
  the agreement on behalf of the City.

  3.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING PROGRESS PAYMENTS
  TO TORO ENTERPRISES, INC.; RESOLUTION NO. 2398-25 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2398-25.

  RESOLUTION NO 2398-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING PROGRESS PAYMENTS TO
  TORO ENTERPRISES, INC. FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 ANNUAL STREET
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECT

2939375.2
 OLD BUSINESS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 24-002; RESOLUTION NO. 2399-25 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2399-25 to terminate Condition Use Permit No. 10-008 and
  approve Conditional Use Permit No. 24-002 for a one-time expansion and
  relocation of the CS Motorwerks motor vehicle repair facility from 31129 Via
  Colinas, Suite 701 to 31117 Via Colinas, Suite 403.

  RESOLUTION NO 2399-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE TERMINATING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 10-008
  AND APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 24-002 FOR THE RELOCATION
  OF A MOTOR VEHICLE REPAIR FACILITY FROM 31129 VIA COLINAS, SUITE 701 TO
  31117 VIA COLINAS, SUITE 403 (CS MOTORWERKS)

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, March 20, 2025 at 4:15 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  March 20, 2025
